name: The Resort at Paws Up
insider_take: Montana's ultimate luxury ranch experience where glamping meets five-star service on 37,000 pristine acres of Big Sky Country.
whats_special: This working cattle ranch turned ultra-luxury resort sits along the Blackfoot River made famous by "A River Runs Through It." Choose from safari-style tents with butler service or rustic-chic homes, all while enjoying activities like white-water rafting, horseback riding, and ATV adventures across endless wilderness.
pro_tip: Book the "Ultimate Paws Up" package during summer for exclusive access to helicopter tours over Glacier National Park and private fly-fishing guides on untouched streams.
dont_miss: The legendary chuck wagon dinners under Montana's star-filled sky and sunrise hot air balloon rides over the Garnet Mountain Range. The resort's spa treatments in outdoor pavilions overlooking grazing buffalo herds are pure magic.
pros: Unique luxury ranch experience with authentic Montana wilderness activities
Exclusive safari-style glamping tents and luxury ranch homes
All-inclusive outdoor adventure packages including horseback riding and fly fishing
Premium spa services and gourmet dining in stunning natural setting
cons: Remote wilderness location requiring significant travel time
Weather-dependent outdoor activities may limit options during certain seasons
